cohort: The study included 44 patients with Caesarean Scar Diverticulum who underwent surgical treatment and 20 control women who underwent total hysterectomy.
finding: Chronic Endometritis (CE) was significantly associated with Caesarean Scar Diverticulum (CSD) and its clinical symptoms, including prolonged menstruation and decreased haemoglobin.
cross-section timing: Assessment was performed at the time of surgical treatment for CSD or total hysterectomy for controls.
